name: Shallot

schedule.notes: Plant sets pointy-end up, tip just at the soil. Or sow seed 12 weeks earlier indoors.
Fall planting (sets) in zones 6+ — winters in the ground, harvests in early summer.
Lift when tops fall and brown. Cure 2 to 3 weeks dry and airy.

harvest.cues: Tops have flopped and started to brown; necks soften. Lift gently; bulb cluster will split into individual shallots.
harvest.storageNotes: Cure 2 to 3 weeks, then store in mesh or braided at 50 to 60 F. 6 to 10 months.

varieties.name: French Grey
varieties.notes: Strong, complex flavor. The chef's shallot. Harder to find as sets.

varieties.name: Ambition
varieties.notes: Large, single-bulb shallot from seed. Reliable, stores well.

notes: From sets: each bulb splits into 4 to 8 over the season. From seed: single bulbs but more flexibility on variety. Same daylength rules as onion — match cultivar to your latitude.
